cash_engine.detail: The cash engine fell 100% from its 2016-12-31 peak to its 2019-12-28 trough and has since regained that peak — a cyclical engine, not a broken one.

stress.detail: Owner earnings held through both real tests — the 2020 demand shock left owner earnings 83% ABOVE the prior peak (2021-01-02); the 2022 rate shock left owner earnings 9% ABOVE the prior peak (2022-12-31). That is evidence no model can manufacture.

predictability.detail: This business can be forecast: annual revenue growth is typically 8 points away from its 2%/yr average and the operating margin is typically 2 points away from its 3% average — steady enough to be valued without a spreadsheet of assumptions.

financing.detail: Not measured — financing fragility: no twelve-month debt maturity on the latest balance sheet (no ingester in this repo maps the EDGAR tag; see the §3.6 provenance); no price history and share-count series to compare across a drawdown. Absent evidence is not safety (§7).

concentration.detail: This filer does not tag customer concentration, so this layer cannot see it — and silence here is not safety (§3.7); the cash-engine probe is what catches the same fragility by another route.
